description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing the state of a troubleshooter component, including event data, date selection, and UI state, with utility functions for query parameter synchronization.

methods.name: useTroubleshooterStore
methods.description: Creates and manages the troubleshooter state, including event, date, and calendar color mapping.

methods.name: useInitalizeTroubleshooterStore
methods.description: Custom hook to initialize the troubleshooter store with given parameters on component mount.
